mechanicsCustomBlock.label: Custom Block
mechanicsCustomBlock.description: The item is placed as a real block (NoteBlock, StringBlock or ChorusBlock).
mechanicsCustomBlock.hint: For blocks, Nexo recommends a non-block material such as PAPER. This item''s model is used automatically.

type.label: Block type
type.help: NOTEBLOCK, STRINGBLOCK and CHORUSBLOCK come with Nexo. With the Carpentry addon turned on in the project settings, its stairs, slabs, doors, trapdoors, transparent blocks, chains, lanterns and bars join the list.

customVariation.label: Variation (unique number)
customVariation.help: Leave empty to let Nexo assign a free number automatically. Do not change it once blocks have been placed!

directional.label: Orientation when placed (like logs)
directional.help: Nexo rotates the model depending on the direction and assigns the variations itself. A face model (here or on the model tab) is used as it is, without rotation.

northVariation.label: Variation facing north
northVariation.help: Nexo 1.30 reads this key; the Nexo docs do not list it yet.

southVariation.label: Variation facing south
southVariation.help: Nexo 1.30 reads this key; the Nexo docs do not list it yet.

eastVariation.label: Variation facing east
eastVariation.help: Nexo 1.30 reads this key; the Nexo docs do not list it yet.

westVariation.label: Variation facing west
westVariation.help: Nexo 1.30 reads this key; the Nexo docs do not list it yet.

upVariation.label: Variation facing up
upVariation.help: Nexo 1.30 reads this key; the Nexo docs do not list it yet.

downVariation.label: Variation facing down
downVariation.help: Nexo 1.30 reads this key; the Nexo docs do not list it yet.

parentBlock.label: Parent block (item ID)
parentBlock.help: Nexo sets this on the generated face blocks itself. Nexo 1.30 reads this key; the Nexo docs do not list it yet.

strippedLog.label: Turns into (item ID of the stripped block)

decreaseAxeDurability.label: Stripping wears the axe
decreaseAxeDurability.help: Nexo 1.30 reads this key; the Nexo docs do not list it yet.

sapling.label: Sapling (grows into a schematic)
sapling.help: The schematics must be in the plugins/Nexo/schematics folder (WorldEdit/FAWE).

immovable.label: Pistons cannot move it
immovable.help: Nexo 1.30 reads this key; the Nexo docs do not list it yet.

canIgnite.label: Can be set on fire
canIgnite.help: Nexo 1.30 reads this key; the Nexo docs do not list it yet.

instrument.label: Note block sound
instrument.help: Sound played when the block is hit, if note block features are reimplemented in mechanics.yml. Nexo 1.30 reads this key; the Nexo docs do not list it yet.

variants.label: Random models
variants.help: Weighted, rotated models Nexo picks from at random for each placed block. Nexo 1.30 reads this key; the Nexo docs do not list it yet.
